name: The Wurmspat
inspire:
If 3 or more enemy fighters are slain or damaged, Inspire each friendly fighter.

After an enemy fighter with any bile tokens is slain by a friendly fighter, Inspire that fighter.

reactions.name: Disgustingly Resilient
reactions.flavorText: Nurgle's chosen are all but inured to pain.
reactions.rulesText: Immediately before damage is inflicted on a friendly fighter by an Attack without Cleave ({icon:cleave}), if the Save roll contained any {icon:shield}, reduce the damage of that Attack by 1.

reactions.name: Grandfather's Gifts
reactions.flavorText: One scratch, and the plagues do their great work...
reactions.rulesText:
Bile Blade {icon:bile-blade}: If the Attack was successful, give the target a bile token after the Attack has been resolved.

Enemy fighters have -1 Move while they have any bile tokens. Remove all bile tokens from enemy fighters at the end of the battle round.

abilities.name: Steady Advance
abilities.trigger: Use this in your Power step.
abilities.flavorText: No need to hurry - there will be boons for all, in due time.
abilities.rulesText: Pick up to 2 friendly fighters. Push each of those fighters 1 hex. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: Nauseous Revulsion
abilities.trigger: Use this in your Power step.
abilities.flavorText: Not everyone appreciates the nature of Fecula's gifts. Ingrates...
abilities.rulesText: Enemy fighters' melee weapons have -1 Attack dice in the next turn. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: Blades of Putrefaction
abilities.trigger: Use this in a Power step.
abilities.flavorText: Vile slime and liquid agues drip from the edges of the Wurmspat's blades.
abilities.rulesText: Friendly fighters' melee weapons have Grievous ({icon:grievous}) in addition to any other Weapon abilities in the next turn. You can only use this ability once per game.

playstyle: Three tough Nurgle elites who advance slowly and grind opponents down. Their bile-coated blades poison enemies, stripping Move so foes cannot escape, while damage-reduction against non-Cleaving attacks makes them brutally hard to kill. Low mobility is the trade-off, so the warband wins by tanking hits, slowing the board to a crawl and dismantling isolated targets over many rounds.
